trial.title: OPTImaL:Optimisation of Treatment for Patients With Low Stage Triple-negative Breast Cancer With High Stromal Tumor-infiltrating Lymphocytes

criteria.description: TNBC defined as invasive carcinoma; ER/PR expression 0-9%; HER2 negative
Pathological stage I TNBC: pT1a/b/c (≤2 cm) and pN0, with no microinvasive disease or isolated tumor cells
No evidence of nodal or distant metastases (cN0M0) on pre- and/or postoperative imaging including 18F-FDG-PET/CT or CT
sTIL score of ≥50% for patients ≥40 years and ≥75% for patients <40 years at TNBC diagnosis on H&E FFPE surgical specimen
Has undergone curative breast surgery (breast-conserving or mastectomy with surgical axillary staging including sentinel lymph node procedure)
Absence of recurrence between curative breast surgery and expression of patient preference
Prior disease history of invasive and/or non-invasive breast cancer, or ongoing treatment for invasive and/or non-invasive breast cancer
Multifocal, multicentric or bilateral breast cancer at the time of screening
Presence of lymphovascular invasion on the diagnostic biopsy and/or the surgical specimen
Other invasive malignancy within 5 years prior to inclusion, except adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer, localized cervical cancer, localized and Gleason ≤6 prostate cancer
Uncontrolled severe illness or medical condition
Any psychological, familial, sociological or geographical condition potentially hampering compliance with the study protocol and follow-up schedule

criterion.description: Minimum age: 18 Years
